rook.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet, TRUE transparent background.
Match ONLY these two supplied source sprite strips EXACTLY in drawing style: a tiny very simple chibi RPG sprite with an oversized head, huge eye, small nose, extremely short compact body, simple flat shapes, dark thin pixel outlines, 2 flat tones per material, very limited palette. Simplify his design to a plain blue tunic, small gold shoulder guards, brown belt, dark blue trousers and boots, short blue cape, plain silver sword. Preserve those identity colors, but make the costume AS SIMPLE AS the two provided reference sprite packs.
EXACT 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 distinct poses on transparent alpha, equal square cells, a 15% empty margin inside EVERY cell. All face RIGHT. One whole isolated sprite in each cell. No text, grid lines, ground, shadows or background.
Row1: idle sword ready; walk left foot forward; walk right foot forward; sword guard.
Row2: jump; crouch guard; light sword windup; straight sword thrust.
Row3: sword overhead windup; heavy sword slash with NO large effect; special sword strike with a SMALL flat gold arc; hurt recoil.
All poses share the same large-head short-body scale. Keep every sword tip fully inside its cell and all cells separated by transparent gutters.
